# SmartPatrol by CloudGen Technologies

> AI-powered smart patrol solutions for workforce management, security operations, CCTV AI analytics, incident management, industry apps, and custom development.

Site: https://smartpatrol.asia
Company: https://cloudgentechnologies.com/
App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.guards.app

## Solutions (15)
- Mobile App — Face Biometric Attendance System
- Mobile App — Visitor Management System
- Mobile App — Vehicle Management System
- Mobile App — QR Code Checkpoint Scan Patrolling System
- Web App — Hospital Management System
- Mobile App — Badminton Court WhatsApp Booking System
- Mobile App — Availability Command Centre (24×7 WhatsApp complaints ticketing)
- Web App — Pharmacy Billing System
- Custom — Web App Development
- Custom — Mobile App Development
- Custom — Website Development
- CCTV — Attendance System
- CCTV — People Counting
- CCTV — ANPR (Automatic Number Plate Recognition)
- CCTV / Mobile — OCR (ID number, name, phone, address)

## USD solution packages
- Essentials — $79/mo · $799/yr · setup $149 (face attendance, visitors, QR patrol)
- Operations — $179/mo · $1,829/yr · setup $299 (Essentials + vehicles + WhatsApp command centre)
- Vision AI — $349/mo · $3,569/yr · setup $599 (CCTV attendance, counting, ANPR, OCR)
- Industry Apps — $299/mo · $3,059/yr · setup $499 (hospital, pharmacy, court booking)
- Enterprise Suite — $799/mo · $8,159/yr · setup $1,499 (all 15 solutions + custom builds)

## Guard-tour subscriptions (EUR / INR)
- Plans: Base, Pro, Gold — mapped to CloudGen solutions
- Base: QR patrol, GPS, schedules, daily reports (visitor add-on)
- Pro: Face attendance, visitors, vehicles, WhatsApp command centre, OCR, API
- Gold: Pro + CCTV attendance/counting/ANPR, trails, BI reports, priority support
- Industry apps & custom builds: add-on / quote on Pro–Gold
- From 2.64 / 5.07 / 9.53 EUR per guard / month
- Guard slider 1–100; >100 requires quote
- Annual billing includes about 15% off
- Checkout via Razorpay (INR)
